RSP the party balen belongs to won because we united as one to fight against the corrupt through the sacrifice of those brave martyrs who died in the GENZ protest the same as our national anthem states. Had that not happened, we might not have seen this political shift. His biggest challenge will be to live upto the expectations of the whole nation who have completely put their faith on him and to give the martyrs who died justice not through punishing the perpetrators but by fulfilling their dreams of making Nepal great. The next challenge he will face is balancing relations with India and China while tackling the americans. We are hopeful that he manages to develop good relationship with both India and China while remaining Neutral in his approach as we have deep ties with both cultures. India through hinduism and buddhism and China with the legendary ancient architect Araniko whos "pagoda style" is the basis for all shrines in china.
